description: Where to eat and drink in Springfield, MO: breweries, food trucks, date night spots and the local restaurants and treats we keep going back to.
intro: Springfield's food scene is bigger than cashew chicken. Local breweries, food trucks, pizza nights on a farm, coffee shops and family restaurants all have a place on our list.
Start with the guides below, then dig into the local spots we've tried ourselves. Hours and menus change, so check a place's own page or social before you go.
